description:
🌊
On the eve of her coronation, Nerissa, the true heir to the ocean throne, is cruelly robbed of her singing voice, her crown and all her memories by Delphine and the deep-sea witch Zephyra. She drifts to the private shore of the wealthy Ashworth family, and Dorian, the cursed human heir bound to sea-blood magic, hides her inside the old coastal manor.

Silent and amnesiac, Nerissa is hunted by doctors, public gossip, and deadly underwater assassins. Her royal mark, silver gate runes and the ocean’s tide keep revealing her true identity layer by layer. With help from Kai, Mara and Dorian, she uncovers the secret of the Silver Gate left by her mother Aurelia.

As the black moon draws near, the false queen’s power begins to backfire. Zephyra plans to feed the Tide Eater behind the Silver Gate — using Nerissa’s stolen voice, the fake queen’s blood, guardian bloodline, and the fear of humans.

Nerissa fights to take back her stolen voice. She holds a public judgment against Delphine, settles every old crime of the Ashworth clan, and seals the boundary between the human world and the abyss. At last, she is crowned as both the mermaid queen and the guardian of the Silver Gate.
